400.description: Error - The input does not match the input schema definition.

401.description: Error - The user is not authorized to create this content type group.

403.description: Error - A content type group with the same identifier already exists.

post.description: Creates a new content type group.

parameters.name: X-CSRF-Token
parameters.description: The CSRF Token needed on all unsafe HTTP methods with session.

requestBody.description: The content type group input schema encoded in XML or JSON.

200.description: OK - returns the content type group.
